input: one JSON object per line, text string of 1..10000 characters
effects: print routing recommendation only; never delete or modify messages
fallback: ham with explicit non-ok status; preserve message, caller may retry/review; not evidence of legitimacy
incumbent: always-ham-v1, cost-optimal constant on fit prevalence
search: word TF-IDF logistic C=1 first; then at most two lexical model changes justified by development errors; thresholds 0.1..0.9 step 0.05 plus 5/6; ties choose larger threshold then earlier trial
split: seed 20260926; shuffled groups 60% fit, 20% search, remainder confirm; no stratification; group means define primary loss
confirmation: one frozen finalist vs incumbent; 5000 paired group bootstrap draws seed 71; one-sided 95% percentile upper delta < -0.005, row ham false-positive rate <=0.01, spam recall >=0.60; approximate conditional proxy evidence, not distribution-free proof
reload: identical actions, absolute score tolerance 1e-12; test input failures and artifact digest rejection
custody: public corpus; full download and unsupervised grouping accessible, confirmation labels excluded from selection by program convention, not enforced access control; no production or future-time claim
